composition: PMIA (Nomex) fibers regenerated from 1.5 g commercial Nomex, 0.6 g LiCl, 18.5 g DMAc and 0.035 g PEO in precursor solution; residual LiCl/PEO final amounts unquantified, no inference of pure PMIA final composition
conditions_locator: SI pp.2-3 Test S2: TG 50-900 C at 10 C/min; main independently identifies TG in air. Argon is for separate DTA and nitrogen for separate DSC.
evidence_method: Complete original primary body and captions and complete official 36-page SI text reviewed; original SI Table S2 and Figure S12 pixels inspected. Exact prose/printed values only, no curve estimation.
limitations: Figure S12 notation T95% means 95% weight remaining: main explicitly defines this as 5% mass loss, mapped to T5_C, never T95-loss. SI p.18 Figure S14 28.40% is a photographed burn oxygen setting, not an alternative reported LOI mean. Source-reported sigma retained without recalculation. Other PTFE/PAN/PP fibers have TG T5 values but no own matched exact LOI here. No multiple states for six repeated splines, areal-density filtration series, 200 C aging, acid immersion or post-filtration wash. Plot ends at 800 C whereas method scan says 900 C; no residue or endpoint-derived TG metrics inferred. Residual processing aids not quantified.
pairing_evidence: Own initial ionic solution blow-spun Nomex nanofibrous membrane has air TG five-percent loss explicitly 376 C in the main Structure and Properties section. The same initial membrane has own mean LOI 28.39 in main and SI Table S2; SI Table S3 documents six repeats. SI Test S2 gives TG-specific 10 C/min; argon DTA and nitrogen DSC are distinct assays. Aging, acid exposure, different areal-density filtration samples and recycled membranes lack own matched TG/LOI, and are not cross-paired.
sample_state: Nomex ionic solution blow-spun nanofibrous membrane
source_location: Main Experimental: Preparation of Nomex Nanofibrous Membranes; Results: Structure and Properties of Nomex Nanofibrous Membranes; Figure 3h; complete SI pp.2-3 Test S2, p.16 Figure S12 and pp.33-34 Tables S2-S3
treatment_method: Dissolve Nomex/LiCl/DMAc at 90 C for 2.3 h, add PEO and stir 0.2 h; ionic solution blow-spin using 0.2 mm needle, 1.5 mL/h, 80 kPa compressed air, 30 cm nozzle-collector distance and 200 rpm roller reciprocating at 1 cm/s; heated platform and infrared lamp assistance; dry collected membrane at 60 C for 1 h.
washing_state: initial prepared material; no durability washing or aging
